references.role: Original general morphology model and published scope; not locally reproduced published benchmark.

setup_failures.reason: Sandbox blocked local MPI sockets before initialization; rerun with scoped permission.
Configuration omitted mandatory PARAM_BUBBLE; following case includes the group with zero perturbation.

scope: Approximate isothermal -20 C, initial water RH 103%, base pressure 700 hPa, 2 km column with particles below 1875 m; 4 x 2 x 16 cells, 125 m spacing.

No air motion, momentum feedback, external cooling, vapor replenishment or resolved turbulence. Constant surface lunar gravity is a diagnostic parameter; the column is not positioned at a specific lunar altitude.
Earth thermodynamic constants, dry-air composition, aerosol population and freezing law retained from upstream.
No new collision algorithm, growth cap, habit constraint or ice breakup was added. Liquid gravity patch retains Earth empirical size regimes and 7 mm speed-law diameter cap.

Active aggregation routine sdm_outcome_aggregation_shima5_multi contains rhoi_min=10 kg/m3 in its geometry interpolation; no branch/contact fracture model. Aggregation is assessed at saved 60 s snapshots; collision events between outputs are not counted.

Water conservation uses post-initialization atmospheric history. Initialization hydrates aerosols before that ledger starts. Native particle dumps precede microphysics; atmospheric history follows it.
Temperature feedback is checked, but a full energy-conservation ledger and observed Earth cloud validation were not performed.
Time step, superparticle count and one additional seed are sensitivity checks, not a convergence ensemble; dimensions, duration, humid histories and meteorological forcing remain untested.

settings.name: earth_start_03
settings.supplied_profile: Approximate isothermal -20 C, 700 hPa base, 103% water RH; not a climate profile.

earth_start_03.water_ledger: sum(DENS * (QV + QHYD_sd) * cell_volume) / horizontal_area + 1000 * mean(PREC_sd). All fields from the same atmospheric history record. Baseline is first post-initialization record; initializer adds hydrated aerosol water before that baseline.
earth_start_03.particle_timing: Native particle dumps precede sdm_calc; atmospheric hydrometeor histories follow it. Same nominal label differs by one main microphysics step. Particle masses are not mixed with history vapor in the water ledger.

evidence: Executed finite-water mixed-phase columns with native vapor/heat feedback, fixed air, settling, riming and evolving spheroidal ice geometry. Numerical feasibility controls; no empirical validation or full-storm convergence.
reading_rule: Read only as the declared 2 km, 30 minute controls and 60 second startup checks. Particle snapshots precede atmospheric history by one microphysics step. Initial hydration water is included at the first history baseline. The saved snapshots do not establish behavior in an aggregation-heavy cloud; their narrow size distributions cannot qualify the historical 15–60 cm tail or its optics.
